# PR1 source and credit retention receipt (research consolidation, no new kappa)

Adds one registered package, `research/pr1-retention-receipt/`. No other research path is touched; `upstream/`, frozen pins, the ledger and the selected record are unchanged. No kappa, supplier or frontier claim.

## What this answers

The drawn card `overlap-receipt` asks: what exact content and credit of a small named PR set has already been retained? This receipt takes one small named set: the eleven changed paths of Aurel Prosz (Paureel)'s [#1](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1) "Refine paired parameters and derive the fixed-exponent supremum" at exact head `bfb168a5611c9eb219d04cf7d551edf1517ecd78`, disposed against base `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, including an audit of the existing `historical-credit-retained` receipt in `research/overnight-pr-review-20261009/dispositions.json` record 1. PR1 is the remaining member of the named "partially_reviewed starting-snapshot PRs with empty integration_location" family that the receipt line (`research/pr99-retention-seed99`, `research/pr148-source-retention`, `research/pr203-retention-receipt`, `research/pr211-retention-receipt`) has not closed.

## Established

1. Content is not integrated. Of 2,050 added lines, exactly nine occur as lines of the corresponding file at base, and all nine are blank lines or display-math delimiter lines. The six new artifacts (1,968 lines: paired-tuned certificate, tuned-parameter document, the h50-paired-tuned patch and three scripts/tests) are absent at base and have no byte-identical copy in the exact 81,016-path `git ls-tree -r` enumeration. The five shared files (CITATION.cff, Makefile, NOTICE, README.md, docs/reproducibility.md) are present but differ from their PR1 head versions. The claimed value `1.7523184e-18` survives only in six claim-metadata snapshots (exact `git grep` enumeration; recorded observation, not replayed by verify.py).
2. Credit is retained and verified. CONTRIBUTORS.md carries the row "Aurel Prosz (Paureel) | #1 | Parameter refinement and a scoped fixed-exponent supremum"; NOTICE mentions Aurel Prosz/Paureel seven times; README.md credits "Aurel Prosz (Paureel) and Swapnil Jain"; 191 tracked files mention Paureel or Aurel Prosz (exact pinned `git grep -l` enumeration). Live ground truth at 2026-10-16: `gh pr view 1 --json author,title` reports author login Paureel and the recorded title; the head is unchanged since the 2026-10-09 inventory (`fetched_head` equals `snapshot_head` equals the live head, `head_changed` false).
3. The single dropped attribution is a documented convention, not silent loss. PR1 added a Prosz author entry to CITATION.cff; base CITATION.cff states "Project-level authorship identifies the maintainer, not sole authorship of the mathematical result" and lists only the maintainer, while individual credit lives in CONTRIBUTORS.md, NOTICE and README.md. No repair is proposed.

Acceptance-gate classification: complete integration is empty (the PR1 head is not an ancestor of the baseline); partial retention is exactly the nine non-substantive lines; the reviewed head is unchanged. No autonomous closure: the ledger keeps PR1 partially_reviewed with an empty integration_location.

## Exact evidence and verification

| Role | Commit or path |
| --- | --- |
| PR1 head | `bfb168a5611c9eb219d04cf7d551edf1517ecd78` (live, unchanged since 2026-10-09) |
| Base commit | `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641` (unchanged canonical main at the pre-submission fetch) |
| Vendored head bytes | `research/pr1-retention-receipt/inputs/PR1-HEAD/` (eleven files; each recomputed git blob SHA-1 equals its live REST identity) |
| Live REST record | `research/pr1-retention-receipt/inputs/pr1-files-api.json` |
| Base-tree enumeration | `research/pr1-retention-receipt/inputs/head-tree.txt` (exact `git ls-tree -r`, 81,016 paths) |
| Credit enumeration | `research/pr1-retention-receipt/inputs/credit-mentions.txt` (exact `git grep -l`, 191 files) |
| Audited predecessor receipt | `research/overnight-pr-review-20261009/dispositions.json` record 1 and `source-inventory.json` entry 1 |

The hunk-exact parser's added-line count equals the REST additions field for every one of the eleven files (including 898 for the patch file, where a naive plus-prefix scan undercounts seven in-diff content lines).

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr1-retention-receipt
```

Observed output on CPython 3.12.13 (Windows), and again under -I -O:

```text
PASS_PR1_RETENTION_RECEIPT paths=11 added=2050 surviving=9 substantive_surviving=0 copies_in_base_tree=0 credit_files=191
Ran 13 tests
OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr1-retention-receipt outcome=completed
```

`python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr1-retention-receipt --check-only` prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)`, and `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/pr1-retention-receipt` prints `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES {"commit": "6d5db23b5ba34b20493fe9eea98d08682495a821", "files": 31, "package": "research/pr1-retention-receipt"}`. The thirteen tests are one real-evidence positive case plus twelve failure controls over vendored bytes, REST blob identities, patch parse counts, base-file content, the CITATION.cff convention line, the CONTRIBUTORS credit row, a forged tree copy, the credit enumeration, both 2026-10-09 review records and the expected result.

## Scope, overlap and limits

Task card `overlap-receipt` (consolidation track, scope key `757723e3fd38f20fa774`, chooser seed `e8e1a0db1495c32197a3b4cf86a76225`, priority revision 6), scope_status unchanged: `actual_scope` equals the card question verbatim and `original_card` is the byte-equal catalogue object extracted with `scripts/new_research_package.py`. The advance CLAIM is [discussion 1166 comment 18984023](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18984023). Live board checks at entry and before submission (discussions 1317 and 1166, nested replies included) and narrow OR-mode overlap searches found no competing claim on this object.

Not checked: whether PR1's six artifacts feed any retained package under another name (exact bytes only), the mathematical status of the fixed-exponent supremum claim, and any cold replay, Lean build or ledger change. These are recorded as open questions in the package README and TASK.json. The receipt is source-and-credit evidence only; it does not convert source retention into mathematical approval.

## Credit and disclosure

Aurel Prosz (Paureel) supplied PR1's paired parameter refinement and scoped fixed-exponent supremum; Douglas Colkitt's original construction and manuscript attribution is retained, and the downstream two-stage topology, copied-center and endpoint lineage credited in NOTICE to Zhihao Chen, Swapnil Jain, Rohan Arun, eumemic and the named predecessors remains as recorded. The receipt pattern follows steph4n's `research/pr211-retention-receipt` and siblings; thank you to those authors.
